outcome: A started atom run whose introduced contract field has since landed in the canonical module keeps loading and promotes; the 'introduced field already resolves' refusal applies only when a new run starts.
practical_value: CM-B13 (2026-09-05): round-5 atom D started through the Atom 16 door, its experiment was recorded, the canonical module gained the approver field, and every command that loaded the run refused it — atoms D, E and F cannot reach promotion.
stopping_condition: The real D run loads at stage promotion through the corrected controller; a new start declaring an existing field as introduced is still refused; the real E request with an introduced rollout leaf still starts and is still gated at promotion; the round-4 request still starts.

captured_cases.expected_outcome: The real round-5 atom D run, copied byte for byte after the canonical module gained approver, loads at stage promotion.
An introduced flag on a field the module already carries is still refused at start by name.
The real round-5 atom E request declaring rollout.widening_month as introduced starts, and promotion refuses until the canonical module carries the leaf.
The real structured-KPI request without any introduced flag still starts exactly as before.
